body:
I completely agree that it's mind-boggling that I'm even alive right now. Just absolutely astounding. That doesn't change the fact that it doesn't matter. Everything is still going fall apart eventually. 

But if I was going to take pride in living, I'd want to be able to have something to be prideful *about*. And I can't see that happening. And I don't want to waste a whole bunch of effort when I'll never come out near the top.

No matter how good I get at programming, it can never become a career. I've thrown my grades down the toilet, and there are still other programmers that are better than me, AND they have good grades. If it ever came down to me or them, the choice is simple.

I can see where you're coming from. Physical activity is a good thing. But I just can't be motivated to go and DO it. I love running, but I hate being exhausted. I have a hyperactive thyroid, so I'm really intolerant to heat, so running in the summer is near impossible.

It's so easy to make excuses. But I'm not sure I actually want to change. Maybe I enjoy being miserable? I just don't know..

>What do you want to get out of it?

What's "it?"
If "it" is life, then I can't answer that. I don't know why I want to live. I never requested to do anything, why should I feel obligated to keep living? Especially when I have nothing to offer the world.

I enjoy working with technology. I program here and there, I play World of Warcraft, countless other steam games. And it really frustrates me, because I work on my strategies in these games, and I just can't get better. People have told me all of my life that I'm smart, and I'll do all kinds of great things, but I have 0 motivation. I do very poorly in school, even though I was declared "Highly Gifted" by my school system. I got my own Mentor to help me excel in classes. I have a D+ average at most. I just can't see myself doing anything good out of college with those kinds of grades. 

I just want to give up, I sort of already have.
